progression.narrative: The performance opens on Dk4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:06.7) introduces G, Bb, centred on F. Phrase 3 (0:30.2) introduces Gs, C, Ds, centred on F. Phrase 13 (5:55.0) introduces D, centred on F. Phrase 19 (8:40.0) introduces Db, centred on C. The line peaks at Gs4 (424.8 Hz) at 2:53.6. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (F4 → Ds4 → F4 → Eb4 → Dk4 → Eb4).
